decision.explanation: Both Liviu Muntean and Thierry Del Poso are explicitly identified as the head of government of Nădrag in the provided sources. D1S3 directly states that Liviu Muntean was the head of government of Nădrag in 2004. D2S2 and D2S8 identify Thierry Del Poso as the head of government of Nădrag, with D2S8 specifying 2005. These are distinct individuals and distinct periods, so both are valid answers under the question’s scope.
